a1_text: Variable-length data items (actual time when the resources used are freed). This item is required. This item does not have to be documented in the implementor's documentation. (8.5.1.11.3, Availability and persistence of variable-length data items)

staged_record.notes: Rule: A.1 220) 'Variable-length data items (actual time when the resources used are freed). This item is required. This item does not have to be documented' (cite.py --check A.1 -> OK §A.1 220). §8.5.1.11.3: 'The resources used by a variable-length data item may be freed automatically when: 1) an object instance ... is finalized; ... 6) the variable-length data item is explicitly or implicitly reduced in size; 7) ... overwritten with a new value. The actual time when the resources used by a variable-length data item are freed is implementor-defined.' (cite.py --check 8.5.1.11.3 -> OK §8.5.1.11.3). No documentation duty, so no §7 row is correct. Determination as implemented (read): every variable-length carrier is managed .NET storage — a DYNAMIC LENGTH elementary item is a native string, a dynamic-capacity table a managed array in CobolDynTable (a shrink by SetCapacity keeps its slots; GrowTo re-seeds re-created occurrences), a variable-length group CobolVarGroup — so resources are reclaimed by the .NET garbage collector once unreachable, at a nondeterministic time, which GR's 'may be freed' + 'implementor-defined' time admits. The companion requirement of the same clause, 'this has no effect on the results of the execution of the program', holds: probe vl.cob at pin (--std 2023): D = 'ABCDEFGHIJ' then 'XY' -> D=XY L=002; C(5)=7, SET CAP TO 2, SET CAP TO 5 -> C5=0 (the kept slot is re-initialized, not resurrected). Empty test-ref: collection timing is nondeterministic and implementor-defined, so no test can pin it (the wave-1 DOC-A.1-113 shape). Caveat for the refuter: the resource-exhaustion path belongs to item 61 / kb/Work/PB1410 (OOM escaping GrowTo), not to the freeing time. Editions: DYNAMIC LENGTH items and dynamic-capacity tables are 2014 introductions (ConstructRegistry dynamic-length-item-2014 / occurs-dynamic-2014). No owning note. || Owning note: kb/Work/PB1535.
